description: Load the waiting handover for this repo when a session starts, is cleared or is compacted; in opt-in auto mode, nudge once to hand over and clear when context grows large - mid-turn as well as at a turn end, because compaction does not wait for a turn to end. Claude Code runs each command with /bin/sh, or Git Bash on Windows, so they are POSIX sh. Each checks for node first: without it, SessionStart prints one line saying so and the other two exit quietly.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '{"systemMessage":"clear-resume needs Node.js 18 or later on your PATH. Install it and restart Claude Code."}'; exit 0; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook-entry.cjs" session-start
